scope: Archive and verify only the completed Go module cache before reclaiming it. This is a reversible cache preservation operation, not a Go build, dependency acquisition, or source change.
acceptance: The selected root is exactly benchmark-work/native-rc-check-v1/go-mod-cache and has no active users before archive creation or removal.

The full XZ archive preserves every member in order with hashes, modes, symbolic links, and internal hardlinks verified against a bounded manifest; cache inodes may not have external hardlinks anywhere under the shared work root.
The cache is re-manifested unchanged after archive verification and immediately before removal.
Archive output is at most 180000000 bytes and its manifest is at most 4000000 bytes; aggregate retained work remains within 4000000000 bytes before preservation output is admitted.
The retained restore instructions require future Go jobs to restore and verify the cache before reuse.
